description: Bid for classroom technology equipment and installation for the New Clarkston Junior High project under the district's 2022 Bond program. Advertised via the Michigan SIGMA marketplace (LightRFP mirror). Scope is classroom technology systems for new school facilities; the advertisement does not confirm end-user laptops, Chromebooks, desktops, printers, or copiers, so verify scope in the full bid documents before pursuing.
scope_note: Classroom technology (AV/interactive systems) for new construction, not a 1:1 student device refresh.
source: Michigan SIGMA marketplace via LightRFP (full advertisement text in search index)
title: 2022 Bond Program - Classroom Technology (New Clarkston Junior High)

description: E-Rate Year 30 (Funding Year 2027-2028) request for proposals for E-Rate-eligible wireless access points: three (3) years of cloud licensing for approximately 4,000 existing Extreme Networks access points (including software maintenance and 8x5 telephone technical support), plus 200 enterprise-class Extreme AP305C access points (or equivalent) and 200 enterprise-class Extreme AP3020 access points (or equivalent). Vendors must hold a valid USAC SLD Service Provider Identification Number (SPIN) and FCC Registration Number and comply with E-Rate program rules. Pricing in USD, no late fees, interest, or taxes per Louisiana requirements.
issuer: Calcasieu Parish School Board (Lake Charles, LA)
scope_note: Network infrastructure hardware (wireless access points), not end-user laptops/Chromebooks/desktops/printers/copiers.
source: Calcasieu Parish School Board E-Rate RFP portal, rfp.cpsb.org (full RFP text in search index)
title: E-Rate Yr. 30 (27-28) RFP 330-WAP - Wireless Access Points
